class AwkRuntimeError < StandardError
  attr_reader :token
  def initialize(message, token)
    super(message)
    @token = token
  end
end

module Builtins
  def self.format_values(values, token)
    fmt, arguments = values[0].string, values.drop(1)
    result, at, argument = +'', 0, 0
    while at < fmt.length
      if fmt[at] != '%'
        result << fmt[at]
        at += 1
        next
      end
      at += 1
      if fmt[at] == '%'
        result << '%'
        at += 1
        next
      end
      flags = +''
      while ['-', '0'].include?(fmt[at])
        flags << fmt[at]
        at += 1
      end
      first = at
      at += 1 while Lexer.digit?(fmt[at])
      width = fmt[first...at].to_i
      precision = nil
      if fmt[at] == '.'
        at += 1
        first = at
        at += 1 while Lexer.digit?(fmt[at])
        precision = fmt[first...at].to_i
      end
      conversion = fmt[at]
      raise AwkRuntimeError.new('invalid format', token) unless conversion && 'discxo'.include?(conversion)
      raise AwkRuntimeError.new('not enough arguments', token) if argument >= arguments.length
      value = arguments[argument]
      argument += 1
      at += 1
      numeric = 'dixo'.include?(conversion)
      if numeric
        n = value.number
        digits = n.abs.to_s({ 'x' => 16, 'o' => 8 }.fetch(conversion, 10))
        digits = '' if precision == 0 && n == 0
        digits = digits.rjust(precision, '0') if precision
        body = (n.negative? ? '-' : '') + digits
      elsif conversion == 's'
        body = precision ? value.string[0, precision] : value.string
      elsif [:number, :strnum].include?(value.kind)
        n = value.number
        raise AwkRuntimeError.new('invalid character code', token) unless n == 10 || (32..126).cover?(n)
        body = n.chr
      else
        body = value.string[0, 1]
      end
      if body.length < width
        padding = width - body.length
        body = if flags.include?('-')
                 body + ' ' * padding
               elsif numeric && flags.include?('0') && precision.nil?
                 body.start_with?('-') ? '-' + '0' * padding + body[1..] : '0' * padding + body
               else
                 ' ' * padding + body
               end
      end
      result << body
    end
    result
  end

  def self.call(name, values, token)
    case name
    when 'sprintf' then Value.string(format_values(values, token))
    when 'int' then Value.number(values[0].number)
    when 'toupper' then Value.string(values[0].string.upcase)
    when 'tolower' then Value.string(values[0].string.downcase)
    when 'index'
      text, needle = values.map(&:string)
      Value.number(needle.empty? ? 0 : (text.index(needle) || -1) + 1)
    when 'substr'
      text, start = values[0].string, values[1].number
      ending = values[2] ? start + values[2].number : text.length + 1
      start = [start, 1].max
      ending = [ending, text.length + 1].min
      Value.string(ending > start ? text[(start - 1)...(ending - 1)] : '')
    end
  end
end

Token = Struct.new(:kind, :text, :value, :line, :column) do
  def position
    "#{line}:#{column}"
  end
end

class AwkSyntaxError < StandardError
  attr_reader :token
  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
    super("status: syntax error at #{token.position}")
  end
end

class Lexer
  KEYWORDS = %w[BEGIN END function if else while for do break continue next exit return delete in getline print printf].freeze
  BUILTINS = %w[length substr index split sprintf toupper tolower close int].freeze
  PAIRS = %w[+= -= *= /= %= ^= == <= >= != ++ -- && || >>].freeze
  SYMBOLS = '+-*/%^!><?:=()[]{},;$'.freeze

  def self.letter?(c)
    c && (('a'..'z').cover?(c) || ('A'..'Z').cover?(c) || c == '_')
  end

  def self.digit?(c)
    c && ('0'..'9').cover?(c)
  end

  def self.name?(s)
    !s.empty? && letter?(s[0]) && s.each_char.all? { |c| letter?(c) || digit?(c) }
  end

  def initialize(source)
    @source, @at, @line, @column = source, 0, 1, 1
  end

  def advance
    char = @source[@at]
    @at += 1
    if char == "\n"
      @line += 1
      @column = 1
    else
      @column += 1
    end
    char
  end

  def tokens
    result = []
    while @at < @source.length
      c = @source[@at]
      token = Token.new(nil, c, nil, @line, @column)
      if c == ' '
        advance
        next
      elsif c == '\\' && @source[@at + 1] == "\n"
        2.times { advance }
        next
      elsif c == '#'
        advance while @at < @source.length && @source[@at] != "\n"
        next
      elsif c == "\n"
        token.kind = :nl
        advance
      elsif self.class.digit?(c)
        first = @at
        advance while self.class.digit?(@source[@at])
        token.kind, token.text = :number, @source[first...@at]
        token.value = token.text.to_i
      elsif self.class.letter?(c)
        first = @at
        advance while self.class.letter?(@source[@at]) || self.class.digit?(@source[@at])
        token.text = @source[first...@at]
        token.kind = if KEYWORDS.include?(token.text) then token.text
                     elsif BUILTINS.include?(token.text) then :builtin
                     elsif @source[@at] == '(' then :funcname
                     else :name
                     end
      elsif c == '"'
        advance
        value = +''
        loop do
          raise AwkSyntaxError.new(token) if @at >= @source.length || @source[@at] == "\n"
          break if @source[@at] == '"'
          if @source[@at] == '\\'
            slash = Token.new(nil, '\\', nil, @line, @column)
            advance
            escaped = { 'n' => "\n", 't' => "\t", '\\' => '\\', '"' => '"', '/' => '/' }[@source[@at]]
            raise AwkSyntaxError.new(slash) unless escaped
            value << escaped
            advance
          else
            value << advance
          end
        end
        advance
        token.kind, token.value = :string, value
      else
        pair = @source[@at, 2]
        if PAIRS.include?(pair)
          token.kind = token.text = pair
          2.times { advance }
        elsif SYMBOLS.include?(c)
          token.kind = c
          advance
        else
          raise AwkSyntaxError.new(token)
        end
      end
      result << token
    end
    result << Token.new(:eof, '', nil, @line, 1)
  end
end

require_relative 'lexer'
require_relative 'parser'
require_relative 'values_fields'
require_relative 'builtins'
require_relative 'streams'

class AwkInterpreter
  SPECIALS = %w[FILENAME FNR FS NF NR OFS ORS SUBSEP].freeze
  class Flow < StandardError
    attr_reader :kind, :value
    def initialize(kind, value = Value::UNSET)
      @kind, @value = kind, value
      super(kind.to_s)
    end
  end

  def initialize(program, arguments)
    @parser = Parser.new(Lexer.new(program).tokens).parse
    @rules, @functions = @parser.rules, @parser.functions
    @function_map = @functions.to_h { |function| [function[:name].text, function] }
    @references, @calls, @arrays = [], [], {}
    @functions.each { |function| analyze_node(function[:body], function) }
    @rules.each do |rule|
      [rule[:first], rule[:last], rule[:action]].each { |tree| analyze_node(tree, nil) }
    end
    @static_error = static_checks
    return if @static_error
    infer_arrays
    @globals = SPECIALS.to_h { |name| [name, Value::UNSET] }
    @references.each do |token, function, _|
      @globals[token.text] = Value::UNSET if scope_key(token.text, function)[0].nil?
    end
    @arrays.each_key { |scope, name| @globals[name] = {} if scope.nil? }
    @globals.merge!('FS' => Value.string(' '), 'OFS' => Value.string(' '), 'ORS' => Value.string("\n"),
                    'SUBSEP' => Value.string(28.chr), 'NR' => Value.number(0), 'FNR' => Value.number(0),
                    'FILENAME' => Value.string(''))
    @fields, @frames, @streams = Fields.new, [], Streams.new(arguments)
    @line_counts = @parser.statement_lines.dup
    @exit_status, @phase = 0, :BEGIN
  end

  def scope_key(name, function)
    local = function && function[:parameters].any? { |parameter| parameter.text == name }
    [local ? function[:name].text : nil, name]
  end

  def reference(token, function, array = false)
    @references << [token, function, array]
  end

  def analyze_node(tree, function)
    return unless tree.is_a?(Node)
    a = tree.args
    case tree.kind
    when :variable then reference(tree.token, function)
    when :array then reference(tree.token, function, true)
    when :in then reference(a[1], function, true)
    when :delete then reference(a[0], function, true)
    when :forin
      reference(a[0], function)
      reference(a[1], function, true)
    when :call then @calls << [tree, function]
    when :builtin
      reference(a[0][1].token, function, true) if tree.token.text == 'split'
    end
    visit = lambda do |value|
      if value.is_a?(Node)
        analyze_node(value, function)
      elsif value.is_a?(Array)
        value.each { |child| visit.call(child) }
      end
    end
    a.each { |value| visit.call(value) }
  end

  def static_checks
    errors, seen = [], {}
    add = ->(rank, token, message) { errors << [token.line, token.column, rank, token, message] }
    @functions.each do |function|
      name = function[:name]
      add.call(0, name, "function #{name.text} redefined") if seen[name.text]
      seen[name.text] = true
      parameters = {}
      function[:parameters].each do |parameter|
        add.call(1, parameter, "duplicate parameter #{parameter.text}") if parameters[parameter.text]
        parameters[parameter.text] = true
        add.call(2, parameter, "function #{parameter.text} used as variable") if @function_map.key?(parameter.text)
      end
    end
    @references.each do |token, _function, _array|
      add.call(2, token, "function #{token.text} used as variable") if @function_map.key?(token.text)
    end
    @calls.each do |tree, _|
      function = @function_map[tree.token.text]
      if !function
        add.call(3, tree.token, "undefined function #{tree.token.text}")
      elsif tree.args[0].length > function[:parameters].length
        add.call(4, tree.token, "too many arguments to #{tree.token.text}")
      end
    end
    first = errors.min_by { |line, column, rank, _token, _message| [line, column, rank] }
    first && "status: error at #{first[3].position}: #{first[4]}"
  end

  def infer_arrays
    @references.each { |token, function, array| @arrays[scope_key(token.text, function)] = true if array }
    links = []
    @calls.each do |tree, caller|
      function = @function_map.fetch(tree.token.text)
      tree.args[0].each_with_index do |argument, index|
        next unless argument.kind == :variable
        parameter = function[:parameters][index]
        links << [scope_key(argument.token.text, caller), scope_key(parameter.text, function)]
      end
    end
    loop do
      previous = @arrays.length
      links.each do |left, right|
        if @arrays[left] || @arrays[right]
          @arrays[left] = @arrays[right] = true
        end
      end
      break if previous == @arrays.length
    end
  end

  def environment(name)
    !@frames.empty? && @frames[-1].key?(name) ? @frames[-1] : @globals
  end

  def array(name)
    environment(name).fetch(name)
  end

  def global_string(name)
    @globals.fetch(name).string
  end

  def subscript(expressions)
    values = expressions.map { |expression| evaluate(expression).string }
    values.join(global_string('SUBSEP'))
  end

  def location(tree)
    case tree.kind
    when :variable then [:variable, environment(tree.token.text), tree.token.text]
    when :array
      target = array(tree.token.text)
      [:element, target, subscript(tree.args[0])]
    when :field
      index = evaluate(tree.args[0]).number
      raise AwkRuntimeError.new('negative field index', tree.token) if index.negative?
      [:field, index]
    end
  end

  def read(location)
    kind, container, key = location
    if kind == :field
      @fields.read(container)
    elsif kind == :variable && container.equal?(@globals) && key == 'NF'
      Value.number(@fields.fields.length)
    else
      container[key] = Value::UNSET unless container.key?(key)
      container[key]
    end
  end

  def store(location, value, token)
    kind, container, key = location
    if kind == :field
      @fields.assign(container, value, global_string('FS'), global_string('OFS'))
    elsif kind == :variable && container.equal?(@globals) && key == 'NF'
      n = value.number
      raise AwkRuntimeError.new('negative NF', token) if n.negative?
      @fields.resize(n, global_string('OFS'))
    else
      container[key] = value
    end
    read(location)
  end

  def boolean(truth)
    Value.number(truth ? 1 : 0)
  end

  def arithmetic(operator, left, right, token)
    a, b = left.number, right.number
    if ['/', '%'].include?(operator)
      raise AwkRuntimeError.new('division by zero', token) if b.zero?
      quotient = a.abs / b.abs
      quotient = -quotient if a.negative? != b.negative?
      return Value.number(operator == '/' ? quotient : a - quotient * b)
    end
    raise AwkRuntimeError.new('negative exponent', token) if operator == '^' && b.negative?
    Value.number(case operator
                 when '+' then a + b
                 when '-' then a - b
                 when '*' then a * b
                 when '^' then a**b
                 end)
  end

  def evaluate(tree)
    a, b, c = tree.args
    token = tree.token
    case tree.kind
    when :number then Value.number(token.value)
    when :string then Value.string(token.value)
    when :variable, :array, :field then read(location(tree))
    when :parentheses then evaluate(a)
    when :assign
      target = location(a)
      value = evaluate(b)
      value = arithmetic(token.text[0], read(target), value, token) unless token.text == '='
      store(target, value, token)
    when :increment
      target = location(a)
      old = read(target).number
      value = Value.number(old + (token.text == '++' ? 1 : -1))
      store(target, value, token)
      b ? value : Value.number(old)
    when :conditional then evaluate(evaluate(a).truth ? b : c)
    when :in
      key = subscript(a)
      boolean(array(b.text).key?(key))
    when :concat
      left = evaluate(a).string
      Value.string(left + evaluate(b).string)
    when :unary
      value = evaluate(a)
      case token.text
      when '!' then boolean(!value.truth)
      when '+' then Value.number(value.number)
      when '-' then Value.number(-value.number)
      end
    when :binary
      left = evaluate(a)
      if token.text == '||'
        boolean(left.truth || evaluate(b).truth)
      elsif token.text == '&&'
        boolean(left.truth && evaluate(b).truth)
      else
        right = evaluate(b)
        if %w[< <= == != >= >].include?(token.text)
          comparison = left.compare(right)
          boolean(case token.text
                  when '<' then comparison < 0
                  when '<=' then comparison <= 0
                  when '==' then comparison == 0
                  when '!=' then comparison != 0
                  when '>=' then comparison >= 0
                  when '>' then comparison > 0
                  end)
        else
          arithmetic(token.text, left, right, token)
        end
      end
    when :call then call_function(tree)
    when :builtin then call_builtin(tree)
    when :getline then getline(tree)
    end
  end

  def call_function(tree)
    function = @function_map.fetch(tree.token.text)
    arguments, frame = tree.args[0], {}
    function[:parameters].each_with_index do |parameter, index|
      argument = arguments[index]
      frame[parameter.text] = if @arrays[scope_key(parameter.text, function)]
                                argument ? array(argument.token.text) : {}
                              else
                                argument ? evaluate(argument) : Value::UNSET
                              end
    end
    @frames << frame
    function[:calls] += 1
    function[:active] += 1
    function[:depth] = [function[:depth], function[:active]].max
    begin
      execute(function[:body])
      Value::UNSET
    rescue Flow => flow
      raise unless flow.kind == :return
      flow.value
    ensure
      function[:active] -= 1
      @frames.pop
    end
  end

  def call_builtin(tree)
    arguments, token = tree.args[0], tree.token
    case token.text
    when 'length'
      if arguments.empty?
        Value.number(@fields.record.string.length)
      elsif arguments[0].kind == :variable && environment(arguments[0].token.text)[arguments[0].token.text].is_a?(Hash)
        Value.number(array(arguments[0].token.text).length)
      else
        Value.number(evaluate(arguments[0]).string.length)
      end
    when 'split'
      text = evaluate(arguments[0]).string
      separator = arguments[2] ? evaluate(arguments[2]).string : global_string('FS')
      target = array(arguments[1].token.text)
      target.clear
      pieces = Value.split(text, separator)
      pieces.each_with_index { |piece, index| target[(index + 1).to_s] = Value.input(piece) }
      Value.number(pieces.length)
    when 'close'
      Value.number(@streams.close(evaluate(arguments[0]).string))
    else
      values = arguments.map { |argument| evaluate(argument) }
      Builtins.call(token.text, values, token)
    end
  end

  def main_record
    return nil if @phase == :END
    record = @streams.read_main do |kind, name, value|
      if kind == :assignment
        @globals[name] = Value.input(value)
      else
        @globals['FILENAME'] = Value.string(name)
        @globals['FNR'] = Value.number(0)
      end
    end
    if record
      %w[NR FNR].each { |name| @globals[name] = Value.number(@globals[name].number + 1) }
    end
    record
  end

  def getline(tree)
    target, file = tree.args
    if file
      status, text = @streams.read_getline(evaluate(file).string)
    else
      text = main_record
      status = text ? 1 : 0
    end
    if status == 1
      if target
        store(location(target), Value.input(text), tree.token)
      else
        @fields.set(text, global_string('FS'))
      end
    end
    Value.number(status)
  end

  def output(tree)
    arguments, redirect = tree.args
    values = arguments.map { |argument| evaluate(argument) }
    text = if tree.token.text == 'print'
             values = [@fields.record] if values.empty?
             values.map(&:string).join(global_string('OFS')) + global_string('ORS')
           else
             Builtins.format_values(values, tree.token)
           end
    if redirect
      operator, expression = redirect
      @streams.write(text, evaluate(expression).string, operator.text, operator)
    else
      @streams.write(text)
    end
  end

  def loop_iteration(body)
    execute(body)
    :normal
  rescue Flow => flow
    raise unless [:break, :continue].include?(flow.kind)
    flow.kind
  end

  def execute(tree)
    return unless tree
    a, b, c, d = tree.args
    @line_counts[tree.token.line] += 1 unless [:block, :empty].include?(tree.kind)
    case tree.kind
    when :block then a.each { |statement| execute(statement) }
    when :empty then nil
    when :expression then evaluate(a)
    when :if then execute(evaluate(a).truth ? b : c)
    when :while
      while evaluate(a).truth
        break if loop_iteration(b) == :break
      end
    when :do
      loop do
        break if loop_iteration(b) == :break
        break unless evaluate(a).truth
      end
    when :for
      evaluate(a) if a
      while !b || evaluate(b).truth
        break if loop_iteration(d) == :break
        evaluate(c) if c
      end
    when :forin
      keys = Value.sorted_keys(array(b.text))
      keys.each do |key|
        store([:variable, environment(a.text), a.text], Value.input(key), a)
        break if loop_iteration(c) == :break
      end
    when :delete
      target = array(a.text)
      b ? target.delete(subscript(b)) : target.clear
    when :output then output(tree)
    when :next
      raise AwkRuntimeError.new('next used in BEGIN or END', tree.token) if [:BEGIN, :END].include?(@phase)
      raise Flow.new(:next)
    when :break, :continue then raise Flow.new(tree.kind)
    when :return then raise Flow.new(:return, a ? evaluate(a) : Value::UNSET)
    when :exit
      @exit_status = evaluate(a).number if a
      raise Flow.new(:exit)
    end
  end

  def execute_rule(rule)
    rule[:count] += 1
    if rule[:action]
      execute(rule[:action])
    else
      @streams.write(@fields.record.string + global_string('ORS'))
    end
  end

  def run_rules
    @rules.each do |rule|
      matches = case rule[:kind]
                when 'all' then true
                when 'pattern' then evaluate(rule[:first]).truth
                when 'range'
                  rule[:inside] = evaluate(rule[:first]).truth unless rule[:inside]
                  inside = rule[:inside]
                  rule[:inside] = false if inside && evaluate(rule[:last]).truth
                  inside
                else false
                end
      execute_rule(rule) if matches
    end
  rescue Flow => flow
    raise unless flow.kind == :next
  end

  def run
    if @static_error
      File.write('output/stdout.txt', '')
      File.write('output/stats.txt', @static_error + "\n")
      return
    end
    @streams.options.each { |name, value| @globals[name] = Value.input(value) }
    status = nil
    begin
      begin
        @rules.each { |rule| execute_rule(rule) if rule[:kind] == 'BEGIN' }
        if @rules.any? { |rule| rule[:kind] != 'BEGIN' }
          @phase = :record
          while (record = main_record)
            @fields.set(record, global_string('FS'))
            run_rules
          end
        end
      rescue Flow => flow
        raise unless flow.kind == :exit
      end
      @phase = :END
      begin
        @rules.each { |rule| execute_rule(rule) if rule[:kind] == 'END' }
      rescue Flow => flow
        raise unless flow.kind == :exit
      end
    rescue AwkRuntimeError => error
      status = "status: runtime error at #{error.token.position}: #{error.message}"
    end
    status ||= "status: exit #{@exit_status}"
    @streams.save
    File.write('output/stats.txt', statistics(status).join("\n") + "\n")
  end

  def statistics(status)
    lines = [status, '[inputs]']
    @streams.operands.each { |item| lines << "#{item[:name]} records=#{item[:records]}" if item[:kind] == :file }
    lines << '[getline]'
    @streams.getlines.each do |name, entry|
      lines << (entry[:opened] ? "#{name} reads=#{entry[:reads]}" : "#{name} missing")
    end
    lines << '[rules]'
    @rules.each { |rule| lines << "#{rule[:token].position} #{rule[:kind]} count=#{rule[:count]}" }
    lines << '[functions]'
    @functions.each { |function| lines << "#{function[:name].text} calls=#{function[:calls]} depth=#{function[:depth]}" }
    lines << '[outputs]'
    @streams.outputs.each { |name, entry| lines << "#{name} writes=#{entry[:writes]} bytes=#{entry[:text].length}" }
    lines << '[lines]'
    @line_counts.sort.each { |line, count| lines << "#{line} count=#{count}" }
    lines << '[globals]'
    @globals.keys.sort.each do |name|
      value = name == 'NF' ? Value.number(@fields.fields.length) : @globals[name]
      lines << "#{name} = #{value.is_a?(Hash) ? "array (#{value.length})" : value.display}"
    end
    lines
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    interpreter = AwkInterpreter.new(File.read('input/program.awk'), File.readlines('input/args.txt', chomp: true))
    interpreter.run
  rescue AwkSyntaxError => error
    File.write('output/stdout.txt', '')
    File.write('output/stats.txt', error.message + "\n")
  end
end

Node = Struct.new(:kind, :token, :args)

class Parser
  ASSIGNMENTS = %w[= += -= *= /= %= ^=].freeze
  attr_reader :rules, :functions, :statement_lines

  def initialize(tokens)
    @tokens, @at, @rules, @functions = tokens, 0, [], []
    @statement_lines, @context, @loops, @stop_gt = {}, :rule, 0, false
  end

  def current
    @tokens[@at]
  end

  def kind
    current.kind
  end

  def take
    token = current
    @at += 1
    token
  end

  def expect(wanted)
    raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current) unless kind == wanted
    take
  end

  def accept(wanted)
    take if kind == wanted
  end

  def newlines
    take while kind == :nl
  end

  def node(kind, token, *args)
    Node.new(kind, token, args)
  end

  def parse
    until kind == :eof
      if [:nl, ';'].include?(kind)
        take
      elsif kind == 'function'
        function
      else
        item
      end
    end
    self
  end

  def function
    take
    raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current) unless [:name, :funcname].include?(kind)
    name = take
    expect('(')
    parameters = []
    unless kind == ')'
      parameters << expect(:name)
      while accept(',')
        newlines
        parameters << expect(:name)
      end
    end
    expect(')')
    newlines
    @context = :function
    body = block
    @functions << { name: name, parameters: parameters, body: body, calls: 0, active: 0, depth: 0 }
    @context = :rule
  end

  def item
    token, first, last = current, nil, nil
    if ['BEGIN', 'END'].include?(kind)
      type = take.text
      @context = type.to_sym
      action = block
      @context = :rule
    elsif kind == '{'
      type, action = 'all', block
    else
      type, first = 'pattern', expression
      if accept(',')
        newlines
        last, type = expression, 'range'
      end
      if kind == '{'
        action = block
      elsif ![:nl, ';', :eof].include?(kind)
        raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current)
      end
    end
    @rules << { token: token, kind: type, first: first, last: last, action: action, count: 0, inside: false }
  end

  def block
    token = expect('{')
    statements = []
    until kind == '}'
      if [:nl, ';'].include?(kind)
        take
      else
        statements << statement
      end
    end
    expect('}')
    node(:block, token, statements)
  end

  def statement
    return block if kind == '{'
    return node(:empty, take) if kind == ';'
    token = current
    @statement_lines[token.line] = 0
    case kind
    when 'if'
      take
      condition = parenthesized
      newlines
      yes = statement
      newlines
      no = nil
      if accept('else')
        newlines
        no = statement
      end
      node(:if, token, condition, yes, no)
    when 'while'
      take
      condition = parenthesized
      node(:while, token, condition, loop_body)
    when 'do'
      take
      body = loop_body
      newlines
      expect('while')
      condition = parenthesized
      terminator
      node(:do, token, condition, body)
    when 'for' then for_statement
    else
      result = simple_statement
      terminator
      result
    end
  end

  def loop_body
    newlines
    @loops += 1
    body = statement
    @loops -= 1
    body
  end

  def for_statement
    token = take
    expect('(')
    if @tokens[@at, 4].map(&:kind) == [:name, 'in', :name, ')']
      variable = take
      take
      array = take
      take
      node(:forin, token, variable, array, loop_body)
    else
      first = expression unless kind == ';'
      expect(';')
      newlines
      condition = expression unless kind == ';'
      expect(';')
      newlines
      update = expression unless kind == ')'
      expect(')')
      node(:for, token, first, condition, update, loop_body)
    end
  end

  def terminator
    return if kind == '}'
    raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current) unless [';', :nl].include?(kind)
    take
  end

  def simple_statement
    token = current
    case kind
    when 'print', 'printf' then output_statement
    when 'delete'
      take
      name = expect(:name)
      subscripts = nil
      if accept('[')
        subscripts = nested { expression_list }
        expect(']')
      end
      node(:delete, token, name, subscripts)
    when 'next', 'break', 'continue', 'return', 'exit'
      take
      invalid = token.kind == 'next' && [:BEGIN, :END].include?(@context)
      invalid ||= token.kind == 'return' && @context != :function
      invalid ||= ['break', 'continue'].include?(token.kind) && @loops.zero?
      raise AwkSyntaxError.new(token) if invalid
      value = expression if ['exit', 'return'].include?(token.kind) && ![';', :nl, '}'].include?(kind)
      node(token.kind.to_sym, token, value)
    else
      node(:expression, token, expression)
    end
  end

  def output_statement
    token = take
    arguments = []
    if kind == '('
      depth, index = 0, @at
      loop do
        break if index >= @tokens.length
        depth += 1 if @tokens[index].kind == '('
        depth -= 1 if @tokens[index].kind == ')'
        break if depth.zero?
        index += 1
      end
      enclosed = index < @tokens.length && [';', :nl, '}', '>', '>>', :eof].include?(@tokens[index + 1]&.kind)
    end
    if enclosed
      take
      arguments = nested { expression_list }
      expect(')')
    elsif ![';', :nl, '}', '>', '>>'].include?(kind)
      old, @stop_gt = @stop_gt, true
      arguments = expression_list
      @stop_gt = old
    end
    raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current) if token.text == 'printf' && arguments.empty?
    redirect = nil
    if ['>', '>>'].include?(kind)
      operator = take
      redirect = [operator, concat_expression]
    end
    node(:output, token, arguments, redirect)
  end

  def nested
    old, @stop_gt = @stop_gt, false
    result = yield
    @stop_gt = old
    result
  end

  def parenthesized
    expect('(')
    result = nested { expression }
    expect(')')
    result
  end

  def expression_list
    list = [expression]
    while accept(',')
      newlines
      list << expression
    end
    list
  end

  def lvalue?(n)
    [:variable, :array, :field].include?(n.kind)
  end

  def expression
    left = conditional
    if lvalue?(left) && ASSIGNMENTS.include?(kind)
      token = take
      left = node(:assign, token, left, expression)
    end
    left
  end

  def conditional
    condition = or_expression
    if (token = accept('?'))
      yes = conditional
      expect(':')
      node(:conditional, token, condition, yes, conditional)
    else
      condition
    end
  end

  def binary(method, operators, skip_newlines = false)
    left = send(method)
    while operators.include?(kind)
      token = take
      newlines if skip_newlines
      left = node(:binary, token, left, send(method))
    end
    left
  end

  def or_expression
    binary(:and_expression, ['||'], true)
  end

  def and_expression
    binary(:in_expression, ['&&'], true)
  end

  def in_expression
    left = comparison
    while (token = accept('in'))
      left = node(:in, token, [left], expect(:name))
    end
    left
  end

  def comparison
    operators = %w[< <= == != >=]
    operators << '>' unless @stop_gt
    binary(:concat_expression, operators)
  end

  def concat_expression
    left = additive
    while [:number, :string, :name, :funcname, :builtin, '$', '(', '++', '--'].include?(kind)
      token = current
      left = node(:concat, token, left, additive)
    end
    left
  end

  def additive
    binary(:multiplicative, ['+', '-'])
  end

  def multiplicative
    binary(:unary, ['*', '/', '%'])
  end

  def unary
    if ['!', '-', '+'].include?(kind)
      token = take
      node(:unary, token, unary)
    else
      left = postfix
      if (token = accept('^'))
        left = node(:binary, token, left, unary)
      end
      left
    end
  end

  def postfix
    return prefix if ['++', '--'].include?(kind)
    result = atom
    if lvalue?(result) && ['++', '--'].include?(kind)
      result = node(:increment, take, result, false)
    end
    result
  end

  def prefix
    token = take
    node(:increment, token, lvalue, true)
  end

  def lvalue
    if kind == :name
      token = take
      if accept('[')
        subscripts = nested { expression_list }
        expect(']')
        node(:array, token, subscripts)
      else
        node(:variable, token)
      end
    elsif kind == '$'
      token = take
      field = ['++', '--'].include?(kind) ? prefix : atom
      node(:field, token, field)
    else
      raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current)
    end
  end

  def atom
    token = current
    case kind
    when :number, :string
      take
      node(token.kind, token)
    when :name, '$' then lvalue
    when '('
      take
      expressions = nested { expression_list }
      expect(')')
      if expressions.length == 1
        node(:parentheses, token, expressions[0])
      else
        expect('in')
        node(:in, token, expressions, expect(:name))
      end
    when :funcname, :builtin
      take
      arguments = []
      if accept('(')
        arguments = nested { expression_list } unless kind == ')'
        expect(')')
      elsif token.kind != :builtin || token.text != 'length'
        raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current)
      end
      if token.kind == :builtin
        count = arguments.length
        valid = case token.text
                when 'length' then count <= 1
                when 'substr', 'split' then [2, 3].include?(count)
                when 'index' then count == 2
                when 'sprintf' then count >= 1
                else count == 1
                end
        valid &&= arguments[1]&.kind == :variable if token.text == 'split'
        raise AwkSyntaxError.new(token) unless valid
      end
      node(token.kind == :builtin ? :builtin : :call, token, arguments)
    when 'getline'
      take
      target = lvalue if [:name, '$'].include?(kind)
      file = atom if accept('<')
      node(:getline, token, target, file)
    else
      raise AwkSyntaxError.new(current)
    end
  end
end

class Value
  attr_reader :kind, :data
  def initialize(kind, data = nil)
    @kind, @data = kind, data
  end

  UNSET = new(:unset).freeze
  def self.number(n)
    new(:number, n)
  end
  def self.string(s)
    new(:string, s)
  end
  def self.input(s)
    first, last = 0, s.length
    first += 1 while first < last && [' ', "\t", "\n"].include?(s[first])
    last -= 1 while last > first && [' ', "\t", "\n"].include?(s[last - 1])
    trimmed = s[first...last]
    body = ['+', '-'].include?(trimmed[0]) ? trimmed[1..] : trimmed
    numeric = !body.empty? && body.each_char.all? { |c| ('0'..'9').cover?(c) }
    new(numeric ? :strnum : :string, s)
  end

  def number
    return @data if @kind == :number
    return 0 if @kind == :unset
    text, at, sign = @data, 0, 1
    at += 1 while [' ', "\n", "\t"].include?(text[at])
    if ['+', '-'].include?(text[at])
      sign = -1 if text[at] == '-'
      at += 1
    end
    first = at
    at += 1 while text[at] && ('0'..'9').cover?(text[at])
    first == at ? 0 : sign * text[first...at].to_i
  end

  def string
    @kind == :unset ? '' : @data.to_s
  end

  def truth
    @kind == :string ? !@data.empty? : number != 0
  end

  def compare(other)
    @kind != :string && other.kind != :string ? number <=> other.number : string <=> other.string
  end

  def display
    return '(uninitialized)' if @kind == :unset
    return string if @kind == :number
    escaped = string.bytes.map do |c|
      { 34 => '\\"', 92 => '\\\\', 10 => '\\n', 9 => '\\t' }.fetch(c) do
        (32..126).cover?(c) ? c.chr : format('\\%03o', c)
      end
    end.join
    '"' + escaped + '"' + (@kind == :strnum ? ' (strnum)' : '')
  end

  def self.integer_key?(s)
    return true if s == '0'
    body = s.start_with?('-') ? s[1..] : s
    !body.empty? && ('1'..'9').cover?(body[0]) && body.each_char.all? { |c| ('0'..'9').cover?(c) }
  end

  def self.sorted_keys(array)
    array.keys.sort_by { |key| integer_key?(key) ? [0, key.to_i] : [1, key] }
  end

  def self.split(text, separator)
    return [] if text.empty?
    return text.chars if separator.empty?
    if separator == ' '
      parts, current = [], +''
      text.each_char do |c|
        if [' ', "\t", "\n"].include?(c)
          parts << current unless current.empty?
          current = +''
        else
          current << c
        end
      end
      parts << current unless current.empty?
      parts
    else
      parts, start = [], 0
      while (at = text.index(separator, start))
        parts << text[start...at]
        start = at + separator.length
      end
      parts << text[start..]
    end
  end
end

class Fields
  attr_reader :record, :fields
  def initialize
    @record, @fields = Value.string(''), []
  end

  def set(text, fs)
    @record = Value.input(text)
    @fields = Value.split(text, fs).map { |part| Value.input(part) }
  end

  def read(k)
    k.zero? ? @record : @fields.fetch(k - 1, Value::UNSET)
  end

  def rebuild(ofs)
    @record = Value.input(@fields.map(&:string).join(ofs))
  end

  def assign(k, value, fs, ofs)
    if k.zero?
      set(value.string, fs)
    else
      @fields << Value.string('') while @fields.length < k
      @fields[k - 1] = value
      rebuild(ofs)
    end
  end

  def resize(n, ofs)
    @fields = @fields.take(n)
    @fields << Value.string('') while @fields.length < n
    rebuild(ofs)
  end
end
